sentence: Actionable disclosure with clear plans earns valuation gains while speculative mentions earn nothing [CITE], and rhetoric that outruns implementation is punished: AI washing first attracts investors, then costs them
passage: [Song, Hou et al. (2026), p. 1] "we find that such narratives initially attract investors but ultimately yield negative market reactions and sustained underperformance." / "markets ultimately punish rhetoric that outpaces implementation."

gemini.overclaim: Actionable disclosure with clear plans earns valuation gains while speculative mentions earn nothing
gemini.note: The passage confirms that rhetoric outpacing implementation is punished after initially attracting investors, but it provides no evidence that actionable disclosures earn gains or speculative mentions earn nothing.
